hooks.prompt: A git commit just completed. Review the committed changes and run /update-docs if any Python source files, configuration, or project structure changed. Skip if only documentation or non-code files were modified.

A git push just completed. If this branch is not main and no PR exists yet for it, run /generate-pr to create a pull request. Skip if a PR already exists (check with: gh pr view --json url 2>/dev/null).
